ColPali's late-interaction operator, $\text{LI}(q, d)$, is computed as the sum over all query vectors of their maximum dot product with each of the document embedding vectors. Mathematically, this is expressed as:

$$\text{LI}(q, d) = \sum_{i \in [|1, N_q|]} \max_{j \in [|1, N_d|]} \langle \mathbf{E}_q^{(i)} | \mathbf{E}_d^{(j)} \rangle$$

where $\mathbf{E}_q$ and $\mathbf{E}_d$ are the query and document embedding matrices respectively, and $N_q$ and $N_d$ represent the number of vectors in the query and document page embeddings.
